text: To reset pairing on Orion 4.2, hold the recessed button for eight seconds.
Orion 4.2 requires USB-C power. Do not use the barrel connector.
Orion 3.1 resets after three seconds. This procedure applies only to version 3.1.
Warranty lasts for two years from purchase and excludes water damage.
The orange indicator means the device is offline. A green indicator means a network connection is available.
Before upgrading firmware, export a configuration backup. Upgrade only after the backup finishes.
Administrators can rotate access tokens in Settings > Security. Existing tokens are revoked immediately.
Do not reset while firmware installation is running. Wait until the green indicator is steady.
